description.en: Adds one item to the DeepSeek Harness workspace menu that moves a workspace to the top of the sidebar once through the host workspace registry. No favorites, pins, stars, automatic reordering or startup re-sort; 8 KB tarball, no runtime dependencies, no saved state.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 工作区菜单里加一项「移到最上面」，通过宿主 workspace 注册表只调整一次顺序。没有收藏、固定置顶、星标、自动重排或启动重排；8 KB，零运行时依赖，不存状态。
